'''Southpoint Tower''' is a ruined scout tower at the far west end of [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], just south of the road to [[Silverpine Forest]]. The Forsaken [[Deathstalker Lesh]] is stationed there, spying on the Alliance activity in the area.
